name: ABC27 Stream
overview: Resolve and expose the ABC27 live stream as a Jellyfin-friendly playlist and redirect endpoint.
description: Adds an ABC27 live stream plugin page plus playlist, stream, status, and icon endpoints. The stream endpoint resolves a fresh Anvato manifest from the official ABC27 watch-live metadata so short-lived stream tokens can rotate without breaking the local playlist entry.

versions.changelog: Initial ABC27 plugin release with dynamic Anvato stream resolution and an embedded channel logo.

name: FOX43 Stream
overview: Expose a FOX43 live stream as a Jellyfin-friendly playlist and redirect endpoint.
description: Adds a FOX43 live stream plugin page plus playlist, stream, and status endpoints so the channel can be fed into Jellyfin Live TV or external M3U-based tools.

versions.changelog: Add an embedded FOX43 channel logo to the generated playlist feed.

name: Music Video Visualizer
overview: Show a live rainbow spectrum over music videos from selected libraries.
description: Adds a configurable Web Audio spectrum overlay to Jellyfin Web playback. An administrator chooses exactly which libraries receive the visualizer and can adjust its bar count, height, and opacity. Other libraries are left untouched.

versions.changelog: Initial preview with selected-library filtering and a rainbow spectrum canvas.

name: Release Watcher
overview: Get an administrator alert when a new Jellyfin server release is available.
description: Checks official Jellyfin GitHub releases at startup and every 24 hours, compares them with the installed server version, and adds a dashboard activity notification when a newer release is available. It never installs updates.

versions.changelog: Render native dashboard rows using Jellyfin 12.4's parallel label and value stacks.
Support the Jellyfin 12.4 dashboard markup and authenticated status requests.
Prevent the dashboard widget observer from refreshing in response to its own status updates.
Add a live Release status and Last update check widget directly beneath Build version on the Jellyfin administrator dashboard.
Add a dashboard Activity entry after every successful check so administrators can see when Jellyfin was last confirmed up to date.
Add explicit assembly version metadata so Jellyfin displays and upgrades the plugin version correctly.
Initial release with scheduled stable-release checks, dashboard status, manual checks, and deduplicated administrator alerts.
